about: Render-zone fixtures for path (a) and tiebreak (b) (ruled 2026-09-27). Self-authored, events-and-state shape: events as fetch_upcoming_events returns them (start/end given as date, clock, IANA zone and rebuilt aware by test_render_zone.py), commitments as process_messages stores them, and a grouping as run_digest passes it - records reduced to the fields the renderer reads (id, ref, identifiers) plus groups carrying render_zone/end_render_zone. Flight numbers are fake. Each summary carries its case tag so its line can be found. Expected lines were pinned from a captured run, never typed before it.
